title: First Adam and Last Adam both loved their bride and took on her sin
summary: Two matching statements under First Adam and Last Adam: Adam loved his bride so much he willingly took on her sin so they would not be separated; Jesus loved His bride so much He willingly took on her sin so they would not be separated.

text.text: Adam loved his bride so much, he willingly took on her sin so they would not be separated.
Jesus loved His bride so much, He willingly took on her sin so they would not be separated.
